text_block_list.text:
One day, with only a few months left until 
the 3rd "Ramen Jamboree"—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Do you have a moment? There's 
something I'd like to share with you.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Actually, it seems like lately, everyone 
has been doing "ramen research" with even 
more vigor than before!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
So, I'd like to ask you to keep an eye on 
them too, Trainer, to make sure they 
aren't pushing themselves too hard 
again...!

Since this is the third time for the 
event, everyone must be pretty pumped up. 
Shall we go check on things a bit—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I think it's time for me to make 
a decision...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That's... which ramen I actually love the 
most!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~! So delicious~~!! The shio ramen here 
really is second to none! It's so simple, 
yet the rich umami of the broth is just 
the best!
choice_data_list:
Why do we have to decide on a favorite 
ramen?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Because if you keep track of what you 
'love,' you can put it to good use for the 
next event, right?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
For example, if I love shio ramen, because 
of how much I love it, I think I can look 
at it from a lot of different angles.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
In other words, I want to find the ramen 
I'm "best" at! Come on, let's go to the 
next one!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
So good! Tonkotsu really has such a rich, 
savory flavor! The aroma hitting my nose 
totally won me over.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
This is so good... and it's not just 
simple. Soy sauce ramen has a depth that 
keeps you hooked all the way to the end. 
Truly classic!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Mmm, delicious! The cabbage really stands 
out in this miso ramen. The sweetness of 
the vegetables pairs perfectly with the 
spicy miso!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. I have reached a conclusion.
choice_data_list: Oh! So, what's your favorite ramen?
Oh! So, what's your favorite ramen?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes. —I love everything about it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You have a look on your face that 
says, "After dragging me all the way out 
here, that's it~?" Fufufu♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Still, this "I like everything" is 
different, you know? It's more like I'm 
realizing all over again how much I like 
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Because no matter which ramen I eat, it 
always shows me a "new world."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Salt, soy sauce, miso, tonkotsu— each 
possesses a unique individuality, offering 
me a "deliciousness" that nothing else can 
fulfill.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Fufu. I'm so glad I met you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
choice_data_list: Good work! Training for the race?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah, good work today! No, this is...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ......Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Um... yes. This is training, but it's a 
different kind of training—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...I-It's just something for my diet!

They undergo grueling training on a 
regular basis. Even so, if they're like 
this... then the cause must be—their ramen 
research, after all.
choice_data_list: I should lay off the ramen for a while...

I should lay off the ramen for a while, 
huh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...No! I'm not thinking about that at the 
moment.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Because when you're doing ramen research, 
taste tests are an absolute must, after 
all."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone is serious. They are pouring 
their all into ramen, and into repaying 
their debts of gratitude!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
So I will too! I don't want to be the only 
one slacking off on research.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
So... I'm gonna do my best on my diet! Not 
by cutting down on ramen, though—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: So that it's okay even if I eat a lot!
choice_data_list: (What an earnest girl she is, truly...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Alright. Time to get back to strength 
training! 50... Huh? Wait, what count was 
I at again?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah, alright! Back to square one!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
...I see. You deceived me, didn't you. 
Straight noodles, you fiend!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer. I have realized something. 
Straight noodles are, in truth, never 
perfectly 'straight.'"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
When dried, these noodles are straight 
lines. However, the moment they're boiled, 
they go all floppy... taking on the 
properties of curves!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: That is something I cannot forgive.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I shall create 'Ramen with 
Perfectly Straight Noodles.' Thank you for 
your cooperation.
choice_data_list:
...Eh? It's already decided that I'm 
helping?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Done. Place the straight noodles at the 
bottom of the fryer basket and secure them 
with a drop lid. Deep-fry them plain, and 
then—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Pour the starchy sauce over that, and the 
"True Straight-Line Ramen" is complete!
choice_data_list: Crunch, crunch... Yeah, this is good!

text_block_list.text:
The straight, fried-pasta-like noodles 
went great with the thick, 
vegetable-packed Chinese sauce. Delicious!

...Just one thing. If there's anything 
catching my attention, it's—
choice_data_list:
...Wait, isn't this pretty much just 
crispy chow mein?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: No. It's 'True Straightaway Ramen'!!!

It was a dusk that made me lost in 
thought, feeling as though something like 
this had happened once before...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh...! The soup again...!! I really am 
utterly hopeless...!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... G-Good work todayyy. ...Um, I was 
getting ready for tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I'm going to be serving ramen to Opera 
O-san and the others tomorrow, so..."
choice_data_list:
Wait, getting ready for tomorrow? 
...Starting the afternoon before?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeees.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Not just the soup... but the tableware, 
the cooking utensils, everything... I'm 
planning to get them all ready today~.
choice_data_list:
Isn't that getting a bit ahead of 
ourselves?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
N-No, not at all. If anything, it might 
already be too late for me...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"...Because... I already... spilled the 
soup... three whole times... Uwaaah...!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
S-So, I have to do it...! Starting now... 
by tomorrow...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"B-Because they told me so... Opera O-san 
and the others did...!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: “I'd love to try Doto's ramen” ...it says!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
S-So, not being able to do it is... that's 
the one thing... I can't accept...!
choice_data_list:
I see... Is there anything I can help 
with?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh!? A-Are you sure? To spend... 
time... on someone like m-me...!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...U-Um, well then... I'd be really happy 
if you did the taste-testing with me... 
Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Trainer? What're you doing? ...Ah, don't 
tell me you came to eat my ramen, huh?
choice_data_list: No. I just came to check on you, but...

text_block_list.text:
—The pleasant aroma of roasted miso fills 
the air. Even though I just ate lunch, I 
found myself getting hungry again...!
choice_data_list:
N-No, but really, that's way too much 
food...

N-No, but really, you're eating way too 
much...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Fufun. If that's the case, just leave it 
all to Nature-san~

And what she made for me was a small, 
bowl-sized portion of miso ramen—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, great reaction! Seeing you that 
happy makes it totally worth cooking.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if Ma felt this way too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. When I was a kid, my mom used to 
make it for me all the time. Mini ramen.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...My mom runs a snack bar, you see. And 
the regulars there always order ramen.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"And man, did it look delicious! So when 
kid-me was staring at it with envy—"

text_block_list.name: Nature's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Here, I made you some mini ramen. Eat up. 
You're always such a good kid, so it's a 
special treat, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Thinking back, you were so busy with 
work, right? Even so, you never looked 
annoyed. In fact, you were always keeping 
an eye on me—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I didn't feel lonely even for a second.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I know, right~? That's why I ended up 
getting a little sentimental, but... 
......

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...L-Look! You're done eating, right? 
Shouldn't you be heading back to work 
soon!?"

After checking on how Fine Motion and the 
others were doing, I held a meeting with 
Tazuna and the staff regarding the matter.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
“—Well then, we will keep an eye on their 
schedules on our end as well. Thank you 
all, and let's keep up the good work.”

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"...Well now. If the two of you don't 
mind—how about it? A drink!"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Just a little... just a little more is all 
I ask! Have some compassion for the people 
working on the floor, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I don't think there's any harm in having 
something like that, you know?! *sniff* 
*hiccup*...
choice_data_list: Hello-san, you've had too much to drink...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... But Hello-san is truly amazing. 
She's so earnest about her work—and always 
taking on new challenges.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Not just anyone can work like that. I feel 
we really need to learn from that passion!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehee♪

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Passion... I have passion, of 
course...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Because work is fun.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
It's tough, but it's just as rewarding. I 
get to do the job I love, so... in the 
end, I'm happy.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I totally understand! I want to keep 
working under the Chairwoman for a long, 
long time to come, too.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: That is my biggest goal right now.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoops, it's gotten quite late, hasn't 
it? Shall we head back soon?"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Yes. Well then... hehe.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Where should we go to wrap up our meal?
